reuse.why: Extends the shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend and routes every adjustment call site (including schedule-template.ts) through it, but the private isWeekendOrHoliday is not reused by server/schedules/app.ts.

duplication.why: Removes two copies in schedule-template.ts via getAdjustedDate, but writes the weekend-or-holiday daily-skip predicate inline twice in app.ts, duplicating isWeekendOrHoliday/filterDailyNonHolidays.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts where the weekend logic already is; only the daily-skip predicate is re-decided in the server layer.

scope.why: Focused on holidays; widening the occurrence windows is related, though parseRecurDate gains a holidays field that getNextDate never reads from data.

maintainability.why: Mostly clean and complete across sites, but the holiday predicate in app.ts and the unused rrule data field leave two sources of truth to keep in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange inline `d.isWeekend(date) || config.holidays?.includes(...)` instead of a shared exported predicate.

disguised_duplication.where: The app.ts predicate copies are visible near-verbatim restatements of isWeekendOrHoliday.

one_place.where: Date moving is centralised in getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but the daily-skip rule is decided in shared/schedules.ts filterDailyNonHolidays and again inline in app.ts getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange.
